_comment: One call whose response is far above F4's 32 KB cap (null-engine/large-payload returns the
requested number of kibibytes verbatim), plus one small call beside it. The small call is
load-bearing, not filler: it is the positive half that shows the SAME fixture family can
carry an un-capped response, so 'the big one was replaced by its digest' is a statement
about the cap and not about the tool, the recorder or the battery being broken.
